references.text: This verse refers to when Joseph ordered his servants to return the money into the brothers' sacks, which created fear and confusion when they discovered the money on their way home.
When they emptied their sacks, each man found his money bag in his sack, leading to further confusion and fear.
Joseph again uses money as a means to test his brothers by placing his silver cup in Benjamin's sack.
The brothers obey Jacob and take twice as much money with them, just as he instructed them in verse 12.
The brothers explain to Joseph's steward that they have brought back the money that was in their sacks, along with extra money to buy food—directly following Jacob's instruction.
This verse confirms the outcome of Jacob's fear in 43:12 by showing that the silver was indeed there and had been returned.
The verse completes the brothers' response to Jacob's instruction in 43:12 to bring back double the silver.
This verse expresses the fear that Jacob hinted at in 43:12 and shows the brothers' misunderstanding before the truth came to light.
